title: She Turned $12 into a $1 Million Business and She Started at Home
promo_conflict: Promotional UpFlip profile of Vicki Cakes with a product taste test; no paid relationship is disclosed.

idea.name: Vicki Cakes mixes and syrup
idea.one_liner: Sell premium pancake and waffle mixes, including gluten-free and dairy-free options, plus original syrup to consumers through direct online sales and retail.
idea.customer: Consumers who want pancake and waffle mixes, including people seeking gluten-free or dairy-free options.
idea.offer: Packaged pancake and waffle mixes based on a family recipe, plus original syrup.
idea.revenue_model: Direct-to-consumer product sales, TikTok Shop, and retail distribution.

acquisition_channels.details: They launched with a website and pre-orders.
They post organic content and use TikTok videos, live sessions, and flash sales to tell the brand story.
They process orders through TikTok Shop.
Affiliates and customers create videos and tag the products.
A broker helped secure placement in HEB stores.
A Good Morning America feature generated a large one-day sales spike.
They used email marketing through MailChimp, then returned to the Shopify platform.

ideas.delivery: The founders source ingredients, mix and bag the products with machinery, then pick, pack, and ship orders in-house; retail orders are also sold through stores. The syrup is part of the product range.

prices: A little under $300,000 cost of goods
platforms: HEB (rendered as HEV in some transcript lines)
